title: Trend 2028-2031: comfort_space
summary: Major China‑market intelligence (McKinsey China Auto Consumer Insights 2026) reports that consumers see city NOA/advanced driver assistance and in‑vehicle AI as essential features and expect higher‑level autonomy by the 2030s—supporting OEM product planning to pair advanced chauffeur‑assist ADAS with rear‑seat comfort and smart‑cabin services in premium long‑wheelbase sedans by 2028–2031.
